screenshots.observation: No tracked PNG/JPEG/WebP product screenshots exist; the only tracked raster image is desktop/src-tauri/icons/icon.png.

claims.claim: NEMESIS is a local-first system for durable autonomous missions.
claims.gap: The installed desktop runs one fixed temporary fixture; it cannot create a user mission from an exact local contract, and active mission state is not restored into the UI after relaunch.

claims.claim: Untrusted workers propose; bounded Ada/SPARK authority decides; deterministic verifiers decide completion.
claims.gap: The fixture path is exercised, but daemon action authorization synthesizes an ephemeral capability and never consumes Nemesis.Kernel.Approvals.

claims.claim: The macOS desktop exposes mission authority, evidence state, replay, and the witnessed local vertical slice.
claims.gap: Authority data and progress are hardcoded, evidence survives only in React memory, and Replay always loads the static phase-11 fixture instead of the last desktop mission.

claims.claim: The desktop has complete navigation for fourteen named product surfaces.
The shipped app reviews the exact normalized action digest before authorization.
claims.gap: The authority panel says digest assigned at execution and never displays the normalized contract or action digest before the click.

claims.claim: Authorization is explicit and does not grant ambient worker authority.
claims.gap: Worker sandbox and capability refusal are exercised, but the operator does not see the exact digest and the daemon approval package is disconnected.

claims.claim: Mission progress and durable state remain available after desktop relaunch.
claims.gap: The UI shows a simulated four-node graph, has no event stream, and does not rehydrate the last mission result on launch.

claims.claim: Workers, capabilities, budgets, context, and workspaces are visible where claimed.
receipts: receipts/adoptions.jsonl chain schema nemesis.rail-adoption/v1 (per local home)

claims.claim: Evidence is source-bound and a one-byte receipt mutation is rejected independently.
claims.gap: The observed property is bounded to the witnessed fixture and named receipt verifier.

claims.claim: Replay reconstructs authoritative state and does not claim identical model-token replay.
claims.gap: The semantics are correct, but the desktop displays a bundled static replay rather than the mission just run.

claims.claim: Policies and one-shot approvals are enforced end to end.
claims.gap: Approval semantics are proved and unit-tested in isolation but no daemon source references Approvals or Consume_Approval.

claims.claim: Desktop settings are real, validated, persisted, reversible, and safe by default.
claims.gap: Settings is a placeholder; no preference schema or persistence exists.

claims.claim: The desktop handles empty, loading, degraded, refusal, corruption, crash, and recovery states usefully.
claims.gap: Errors collapse to generic strings, evidence injects fake two-claim rows, and no corruption or recovery guidance exists.

claims.claim: The desktop is keyboard-operable with native menus, focus management, window restoration, and quit/relaunch semantics.
claims.gap: Native button tabbing exists, but there are no application menus, accelerators, modal focus transfer, arrow-key navigation, or restoration test.

claims.claim: The installed app is self-contained and does not require a source checkout.
claims.gap: The v0.1.0 app runs from bundled resources, but the mission path executes bundled mutable Python/shell scripts and depends on system Python.

claims.claim: The release contains no private paths, credentials, debug symbols, dev servers, or unsafe mutable runtime dependencies.
claims.gap: Leak and symbol gates passed for v0.1.0, but executable bundled scripts remain and the Mach-O sanitizer test is synthetic.

claims.claim: The SPARK proof covers the authority-bearing production kernel.
claims.gap: Eight pure kernel bodies are proved; authority-persistence daemon units are SPARK_Mode Off, proof counts are not checked, and no A-B-A proof calibration exists.

claims.claim: Independent autonomous external security review has accepted the exact production source.
claims.gap: Only builder-owned Phase 16 review exists; no fresh independent reviewer receipts target this mission hash.

claims.claim: Dependencies, lockfiles, action pins, license notices, advisories, SBOM, and provenance are release-gated.
claims.gap: Current advisories and licenses pass and Actions are commit-pinned, but no production SBOM/provenance artifact is emitted or validated.

claims.claim: Reliability covers crash, corruption, migration, concurrency, resource denial, soak, and duplicate suppression.
claims.gap: Core restart and byte corruption are covered; kill-during-commit, disk-full, concurrent ownership, upgrade, uninstall, soak, and UI relaunch are not.

claims.claim: The production UI passes keyboard, VoiceOver, contrast, scalable-text, reduced-motion, and minimum-window gates.
claims.gap: Reduced motion and text+glyph status exist, but load-bearing text is 7-9px and no VoiceOver, contrast, keyboard-only, scaling, or native accessibility-tree evidence exists.

claims.claim: Controlled launch, idle, mission, replay, growth, soak, and package performance are measured with validated instruments.
claims.gap: No performance instrument, raw dataset, reconciliation, or threshold exists.

claims.claim: A normal macOS install, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, and update policy are verified.
claims.gap: v0.1.0 is a ZIP requiring Open Anyway; no /Applications clean-root test, upgrade migration, rollback, uninstall, or explicit authenticated-update exclusion gate exists.

claims.claim: The public artifact is Developer ID signed, hardened-runtime signed, notarized, and Gatekeeper accepted.
claims.gap: The predecessor is explicitly ad-hoc signed, not notarized, and Gatekeeper rejected it. Current Developer ID/notary capability remains to be mechanically re-probed.

claims.claim: Telemetry is absent or opt-in and mission data never leaves the Mac without bounded authority.
claims.gap: The bounded worker denies network and no telemetry library is present, but privacy/data-location/export/delete/support documentation and product gates are absent.

claims.claim: Users can generate a bounded, previewable, secret-scanned support bundle and run installed-product diagnostics.
claims.gap: System status checks file presence only; no support bundle, database/verifier/sandbox health, redaction, or troubleshooting matrix exists.

claims.claim: Hosted CI and independent review are green on the exact production pull-request head.
claims.gap: Historical v0.1.0 CI is green, but the mission branch has no upstream or pull request and no current-head hosted run.

claims.claim: Successor release assets are built from the final merge, published, anonymously downloaded, and byte-identical.
claims.gap: Only the immutable predecessor epoch has release/readback evidence.

claims.claim: Mobile, web, remote-public, Windows, Linux, App Store, and legal work are excluded from this desktop mission.
claims.gap: None at admission; final non-interference fingerprints remain required.
